cues: Connective tissue comes in four groups: loose, dense, skeletal and fluid.
Loose areolar tissue is the body's packing material, under the skin and around every organ.
Fill it with fat cells and it becomes adipose tissue.
Each fat cell is almost entirely one big droplet, with the nucleus squeezed to one side like a signet ring.
